Inventory accuracy: ongoing stock miscounts are small but rising — about 850 single-unit discrepancies/month in pick locations, up 24% since January (now ~940/month), worth roughly €20-25k/month.

It's a picking/process issue, not a tracking-tech issue: mismatches cluster heavily in high-SKU apparel/footwear lines, while items tracked by lot or serial number (food, appliances) actually show fewer discrepancies per unit sold.

A separate one-time ~€138k year-end stock correction on Dec 31 was ~94% concentrated in just 5 B2B wholesale merchants (office/industrial supplies) — likely an annual stocktake true-up, being confirmed with ops before we treat it as a trend.
